evidence.interpretation: The first statement approves the shared labelWrap name for Tabs and Button and fullWidth for Tabs. The Tabs plan resolves the shared semantic ID. Button implementation and its usage registration remain separately scoped; this record is not native review authority.

convention.name: fullWidth
convention.meaning: Whether a segmented tab list fills available width and distributes triggers equally.
convention.whenToUse: Distribute segmented tabs equally across the available list width.
convention.avoid: Do not use for arbitrary element width, constrained content rows, underline tabs or label wrapping.

convention.name: labelWrap
convention.meaning: Whether a control permits its visible label to wrap, including inside long unbroken words.
convention.whenToUse: Opt into line breaking for a control label; alignment and sizing remain component-specific.
convention.avoid: Do not use for arbitrary child content, a section wrapper, truncation or generic flex wrapping.
